errors.text: The predicted fracture response is left as low or only slightly improved, whereas the target reports a substantial increase from about 11.6% to 14.0%, or approximately 20.6%.

The explanation of lattice contraction is confused: it attributes contraction partly to Cr leaving the matrix and to depletion of larger Hf/Zr atoms, rather than clearly tying the measured BCC contraction and distortion to Cr incorporation and associated solid-solution hardening.

The cited evidence does not directly establish that a roughly 4 vol.% reticulated Laves network improves fracture strain in this alloy; one cited refractory-alloy study instead concerns much larger brittle Laves fractions, while the other evidence is largely unrelated.
